title: Foundations: The Two Conditions and the Lord's Going Forth in Ordered Fullness
summary: The opening section establishes the architectural foundations of the doctrine. T1 (the forming of Adam at the lowest depth) and T2 (the Two Trees as five-membered organisms) state the foundational dualism between what the Lord plants and what the soul has claimed, articulated through the rational's five degrees. T3 unfolds wisdom, power, and goodness at three registers (Father, cosmos, elements). T4 unfolds the four great days of the Lord's going-forth, mirrored by four nights of the proprium. T5 sets four faces of Light against four counterparts of Darkness; T6 articulates the Five Worlds of Darkness as the natural mind under self-love; T7 culminates in the Five Fathers as successive divine emanations. Together these teachings give the structural grammar through which all later elaboration is read.
organizing_principle: Numerical fullness ascending (two → three → four → five), with each register adding depth to the foundational dualism. T2 is given full development as the central foundation; T3-T7 are progressive elaborations in which the Lord's going-forth at each numerical register is paired with the proprium's matching articulation. The five-fold pattern that dominates the corpus is established here as the rational in its complete articulation.
